title: Rate limiter

milestones.title: [P2.1] Rate limiter: deterministic-clock implementation and boundary tests
milestones.task: Implement token refill and cost subtraction using a supplied clock. Clamp to capacity and preserve the last timestamp when time moves backward. Explain how tokens differ from a request-per-fixed-window counter.
milestones.failureInjection: A backward wall clock must not mint tokens later by overwriting the previous timestamp. Test half-token waits and the exact eligibility boundary.
milestones.evidence: Exhaust a capacity-two bucket, show a 0.5-second retry estimate halfway to refill, and admit exactly once after one second.
milestones.testCommand: py -3 -m unittest discover -s projects/tests -p test_projects.py -k P2_1 -v
milestones.stopCondition: Stop when the focused deterministic test passes and the stated evidence is recorded. Extensions are separate practice.

milestones.title: [P2.2] Rate limiter: atomic shared state and failure policy
milestones.task: Run fifty concurrent requests against one tenant at a frozen clock and capacity ten. Read, refill, check, and update within one write transaction; report SQLite contention as distinct from an allowed request.
milestones.failureInjection: Separate SELECT and UPDATE transactions permit concurrent callers to spend the same tokens. Reproduce the risk conceptually and verify the transactional implementation admits exactly ten.
milestones.evidence: Capture fifty results with exactly ten admissions and forty denials. Explain what the database lock protects and how a distributed store would need equivalent atomicity.
milestones.testCommand: py -3 -m unittest discover -s projects/tests -p test_projects.py -k P2_2 -v
milestones.stopCondition: Stop when the focused deterministic test passes and the stated evidence is recorded. Extensions are separate practice.

milestones.title: Design rate limiter I / [P2.3]: regional quotas and coordination budgets
milestones.task: Allocate a global capacity of one hundred as EU sixty and US forty. Demonstrate that partitioned regions can enforce their portions without coordination, and identify stranded capacity when demand shifts.
milestones.failureInjection: Reallocating reservations before the old owner relinquishes them can temporarily double-spend. Specify an ownership epoch or conservative transfer procedure as a design extension.
milestones.evidence: Reject allocations summing above one hundred; document a regional imbalance scenario and the deliberate availability/utilization tradeoff.
milestones.testCommand: py -3 -m unittest discover -s projects/tests -p test_projects.py -k P2_3 -v
milestones.stopCondition: Stop when the focused deterministic test passes and the stated evidence is recorded. Extensions are separate practice.

milestones.title: Design rate limiter II / [P2.4]: load/failure tests and policy defense
milestones.task: Inject a store outage under both policies. Fail-open preserves service access while admitting unmetered work; fail-closed protects scarce or costly resources while rejecting eligible work. Select policies separately for login defense and optional analytics.
milestones.failureInjection: Do not silently treat infrastructure errors as normal denials. Return a degraded marker and propose separate alerts for limiter availability and policy rejection rate.
milestones.evidence: Provide the concurrent admission count, both outage outcomes, and a written policy defense tied to business cost and abuse risk.
milestones.testCommand: py -3 -m unittest discover -s projects/tests -p test_projects.py -k P2_4 -v
milestones.stopCondition: Stop when the focused deterministic test passes and the stated evidence is recorded. Extensions are separate practice.

baselineArtifact: Local limiter, shared-state limiter, regional quota design
authorship: original prepared teaching implementation; curriculum names and milestone IDs source-derived
invariant: An atomic bucket admits at most its starting capacity plus elapsed refill; regional reservations never exceed the global allocation.
requirements: Implement deterministic token-bucket boundaries with explicit capacity, refill rate, clock, and request cost.
Serialize shared read/refill/debit using SQLite BEGIN IMMEDIATE. Preserve per-tenant isolation.
Choose fail-open or fail-closed explicitly; report degraded decisions. Regional quotas are disjoint reservations rather than a fictional global counter.
architecture: tenant request → validation → atomic bucket refill/debit → allowed or retry_after. Regional design allocates conserved token ceilings before a partition occurs.
limitations: SQLite is one shared authority on one machine. Regional allocation is a static accounting model. Dynamic quota transfer, distributed clocks and an HTTP proxy are extensions.
extensions: Add expiry/cleanup for inactive tenants and test capacity after eviction.
Implement conservative reservation transfers with fencing tokens.
referenceReveal: Explicit reveal in the academy; reference source also remains inspectable on disk. Educational spoiler control, not secure examination.
